# ReminderZ & Project Loom

Experiments in organizing messages and visual Python programming.

- Dates: 2025
- Status: Desktop prototypes
- Areas: Software engineering; AI / ML
- Stack: Python · Gemini · Electron · FAISS
- Topics: Python; AI Agents; Notes; Productivity; Web/API
- Public case study: https://mgiorgetti.com/project_details/project-remainder-v0.html

## Problem

Notes-to-self can become difficult to retrieve, while visual programming needs explicit connections between execution order and data inputs.

## Contribution

Solo development of two desktop prototypes: ReminderZ for message organization and Project Loom for visual Python programming, retrieval and UI-generation experiments.

## Technical approach and public case study

Two prototypes for organizing messages and building Python programs visually.

- Python · Gemini · Electron · FAISS

- Solo development

### Message organization

Gemini organizes notes-to-self into projects and reminders. Answers link back to their source messages.

- Import Telegram messages

- Organize Schema-constrained Gemini output

- Recall Projects, reminders, and source references

Message processing flow. Telegram fetching supplies an input path; a separate WhatsApp browser utility explores message access.

### Visual programming

Connect execution and value pins in an Electron editor. The compiler walks the graph from BeginPlay to generate Python, with function blocks drawn from existing modules.

Execution connections determine order; value connections supply inputs.

### Search and UI generation

**Local retrieval**

Loom uses FAISS and local EmbeddingGemma embeddings to retrieve documents by meaning.

**UI generation**

Shape and aspect-ratio rules turn drawn rectangles and circles into UI components.

## Results and limitations

These are separate experiments presented together, not a claim of one finished product. The public case study describes schema-constrained organization, graph compilation and local retrieval without reporting retrieval accuracy or production adoption.
